    Modules not killed by J are projective #

    If z ∈ e_y A e_x generates the socles of both A e_x and e_y A, then the pairing (t, w) ↦ ξ (t w) makes A e_x the k-dual of e_y A. An indecomposable module M with z m ≠ 0 then receives A e_x as a direct summand, so M ≅ A e_x is projective (projective_of_socles).
